blind.description: A stylized aquatic altar piece or token consisting of a circular turquoise pedestal trimmed with carved wave and seashell reliefs. Rising from the plinth are dramatic curling sea-green ocean waves tipped with white frothy crests that wrap around a silver three-pronged trident featuring a diamond-shaped cyan gem at its base. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with hand-painted textures, standing flat on its integral circular base with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A circular medallion or base containing curled arcs of white frothy waves overlapping a turquoise core, with the thin top edge of the trident cutting across the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the figure (around 2 feet tall) and roughly the same width as the figure's cylinder base.
